Cuba – the birthplace of tobacco culture. It was here, in 1492, that Christopher Columbus’s crew first witnessed the native people smoking “bundles of leaves filled with tobacco.” Since then, Cuba has become the world’s leading producer of tobacco and is considered the finest terroir for growing cigar tobacco and crafting the most prestigious and expensive cigars. We present to you a unique Cuban blend , crafted in the same way as a premium cigar mix — using cigar leaves: Ligero, Viso, two types of Seco , and a wrapper leaf. It offers a smooth medium strength with notes of creamy caramel, milk chocolate, and hints of nuts . A perfect pairing with single malt whisky or bourbon .

ANDULLO tobacco has been produced for over 500 years using the oldest tobacco processing method in the Dominican Republic. This is a handcrafted tradition passed down from Dominican ancestors and preserved through the centuries thanks to the exceptional qualities it gives the tobacco — namely, its powerful strength and wonderfully intoxicating aroma of wood, spices, and hints of tropical honey. A perfect pairing with peaty whisky and dark rum. We managed to obtain and capture the taste and aroma of this unique tobacco for hookah smoking. Aged in a barrel since 2020.

Description Serbetli made on the basis of honey, which gives it a slightly sweet natural taste. The cut of tobacco is quite large, the leaf is very well impregnated. The main difference from tobaccos of other manufacturers is heat resistance and high humidity, which allows you to enjoy the taste longer and heat the tobacco for more smokiness, while the tobacco does not taste bitter at all. This tobacco is great for beginners as it is very easy to make without fear of burning. Sherbetli is also famous for its very high smokiness, much higher than competitors such as Al Fakher or Nakhla. The Serbetli flavor line initially consisted of only 20 flavors, but in 2014 the line expanded significantly and now includes more than 60 flavors. Tobacco is produced in Turkey, in the city of Trabzon. Possible packaging is 50 and 250 grams. Serbetli is a great alternative to Starbuzz, but with a more natural taste. Of the advantages of tobacco – its smoke and heat resistance, of the minuses – low strength.

Description Serbetli made on the basis of honey, which gives it a slightly sweet natural taste. The cut of tobacco is quite large, the leaf is very well impregnated. The main difference from tobaccos of other manufacturers is heat resistance and high humidity, which allows you to enjoy the taste longer and heat the tobacco for more smokiness, while the tobacco does not taste bitter at all. This tobacco is great for beginners as it is very easy to make without fear of burning. Sherbetli is also famous for its very high smokiness, much higher than competitors such as Al Fakher or Nakhla. The Serbetli flavor line initially consisted of only 20 flavors, but in 2014 the line expanded significantly and now includes more than 60 flavors. Tobacco is produced in Turkey, in the city of Trabzon. Possible packaging is 50 and 250 grams. Serbetli is a great alternative to Starbuzz, but with a more natural taste. Of the advantages of tobacco – its smoke and heat resistance, of the minuses – low strength.

Severnyi Tobacco – “Sequoia” (100g) Core Series • Resinous Pine & Conifer • Earthy & Woody A deep, resinous journey into the ancient forests. Satyr Brilliant Collection – Cubita Colombia 100g Satyr Brilliant Collection – Cubita Colombia 100g Premium Colombian Tobacco • Smooth Coffee Undertones • Elite Cigar Leaf A masterpiece of South American tobacco heritage. As part of the prestigious Brilliant Collection, Cubita Colombia is a tribute to the rich, volcanic soil of the Colombian highlands. This blend features premium fermented cigar leaf specifically selected for its velvety texture and naturally sweet, aromatic profile. Unlike the aggressive strength of the Ligero, Cubita Colombia offers a refined, medium-to-strong body characterized by deep notes of toasted cocoa, roasted coffee beans, and a creamy nuttiness. Satyr Brilliant Collection – Nicaragua Ligero 100g Nicaraguan Cigar Leaf • Maximum Strength • Connoisseur’s Edition The pinnacle of strength and cigar leaf nobility. The Brilliant Collection presents Nicaragua Ligero—a product crafted for those who refuse to compromise. Ligero represents the topmost leaves of the tobacco plant, receiving the maximum amount of sunlight, which makes them the strongest, most oily, and flavor-dense part of the harvest. During the session, the deep, multifaceted profile of an elite Nicaraguan cigar unfolds: notes of noble wood, cured leather, and a light earthiness with a nutty aftertaste. This is not just a smoke; it is a ritual for experts who appreciate the natural magic of fermented cigar leaf and a dense, enveloping body.

Satyr Brilliant Collection – Sea (100g) Non-Aromatic Excellence • Mineral & Saline Profile • Pure Artisanal Tobacco The essence of the ocean, captured in leaf. Satyr Sea is a standout release within the non-aromatic Brilliant Collection, where the “flavor” is achieved entirely through the masterful manipulation of tobacco fermentation. This blend offers a unique, refreshing profile characterized by subtle mineral notes and a distinct saline finish, reminiscent of fresh sea air. For the connoisseur who values the natural complexity of the tobacco plant over added flavorings, Sea provides a crisp, medium-strength session with a clean body and a revitalizing aftertaste.

Satyr Brilliant Collection – Suzdal (100g) Non-Aromatic Excellence • Toasted Bread & Sweet Cream • Artisanal Curing The crown jewel of unflavored tobacco artistry. Satyr Suzdal is a highlight of the non-aromatic Brilliant Collection, where the flavor is derived entirely from the expert selection and processing of the leaf itself. Suzdal offers a sophisticated, savory-sweet profile reminiscent of toasted bread crust and delicate sweet cream, achieved through meticulous fermentation and aging. For the purist who demands complexity without chemical additives, this blend provides a medium-strength session with a rich, natural tobacco body and a lingering, creamy finish.

Satyr Old School – Balalaika (100g) Spirit Series • National Treasure • Vodka & Toast Synergy The true rhythm of Russian craft. Satyr Balalayka is a soulful centerpiece of the prestigious Old School collection. This blend represents a masterclass in traditional infusion, capturing the crisp, clean essence of high-quality grain vodka combined with the subtle, warm aroma of toasted bread. Built on Satyr’s signature artisanal fermented tobacco, Balalayka offers a medium-to-strong session characterized by its honest strength and a sophisticated “boozy” throat hit. It is an emotional and rugged smoke designed for those who appreciate a pure, spirit-forward profile that highlights the raw beauty of the tobacco leaf.

Satyr Old School – Black 100G Pure Dark Leaf • Unflavored • Robust Tobacco The raw, unfiltered essence of premium tobacco. Black is a bold, uncompromising blend from Satyr’s Old School collection, crafted strictly for purists who seek a pure, unflavored smoking experience. It strips away the sweet aromatics to highlight the authentic, full-bodied character of fermented cigar and burley leaf , delivering deep, earthy, and slightly woody notes. A highly robust and natural session designed for experienced smokers who appreciate the true, unadulterated taste and heavy buzz of high-quality craft tobacco.

Satyr Old School – Black Jack (100g) Spirit Series • Single Malt Synergy • Peated Whiskey Profile The definitive choice for the tobacco purist. Satyr Black Jack is a cornerstone of the prestigious Old School collection. This blend isn’t just a flavor; it is a masterclass in tobacco infusion, capturing the deep, smoky, and “peated” essence of premium single malt whiskey. Built on a base of artisanal fermented leaves, Black Jack offers a medium-to-strong session where the woody, boozy notes of spirits work in perfect synergy with the natural strength of the tobacco. It is a bold, emotional, and sophisticated smoke designed for those who appreciate the raw character of high-end craft shisha.

Satyr Old School – Bootlegger Brothers (100g) Spirit Series • Barrel-Aged Infusion • Bourbon & Oak Profile The spirit of the prohibition era in every cloud. Satyr Bootlegger Brothers is a standout masterpiece from the prestigious Old School collection. This blend is a tribute to the craft of traditional infusion, capturing the rich, warming essence of American bourbon aged in charred oak barrels. Built on a base of hand-selected fermented tobacco leaves, Bootlegger Brothers offers a medium-to-strong session characterized by notes of caramel, vanilla, and a distinct woody smoke. It is a bold, emotional, and deeply satisfying smoke for those who seek the authentic synergy of high-end spirits and artisanal tobacco.

Satyr Old School – Burley Cognac (100g) Spirit Series • Noble Infusion • Aged Brandy & Dark Leaf The height of tobacco sophistication. Satyr Burley Cognac is a premier offering from the Old School collection, celebrating the historic “synergy” between high-quality spirits and dark tobacco. This blend features a robust, air-cured Burley base infused with the elegant, warming notes of aged French cognac. Expect a medium-to-strong session characterized by a deep tobacco body, accented by hints of dried fruits, oak, and a velvety grape-distillate finish. It is a refined, emotional smoke designed for those who appreciate the craftsmanship of a truly “Old School” Russian shisha experience.

Satyr Old School – Horizon (100g) Spirit Series • Wine-Cask Infusion • White Wine & Floral Fruit A sophisticated view of the tobacco landscape. Satyr Horizon is a refined masterpiece from the prestigious Old School collection. This blend focuses on the elegant “synergy” between premium fermented tobacco and the crisp, acidic, and floral notes of white wine. Built on a base of hand-selected craft leaves, Horizon offers a medium-strength session characterized by a light boozy edge, hints of white grape, and a subtle elderflower finish. It is an intellectual, emotional smoke designed for those who seek a light yet complex spirit-inspired experience that celebrates the natural beauty of the leaf.

Satyr Old School – Jungle (100g) Spirit Series • Spiced Rum Infusion • Tropical & Woody Depth Enter the heart of the wild. Satyr Jungle is a powerful and exotic masterpiece from the prestigious Old School collection. This blend represents a masterclass in spirit infusion, capturing the rugged, warming essence of dark spiced rum aged in tropical climates. Built on Satyr’s signature fermented tobacco base, Jungle offers a medium-to-strong session where the notes of molasses, black pepper, and charred oak work in total synergy with the earthy tobacco leaf. It is a bold, emotional, and deeply saturated smoke designed for those who seek a sophisticated spirit profile with a heavy, satisfying body.

Satyr Old School – Kaizen (100g) Zen Series • Green Tea Harmony • Subtle & Dynamic The art of continuous improvement in every pull. Satyr Kaizen is a uniquely intellectual offering from the prestigious Old School collection. Inspired by the Japanese philosophy of “Kaizen,” this blend features a delicate “synergy” of premium fermented tobacco and the subtle, refreshing notes of high-quality green tea. The experience begins with a gentle, refreshing sourness that gracefully transitions into a dense, sweet-spicy tobacco bouquet. Built on Satyr’s signature craft leaf, it offers a medium-strength session that is clean, calming, and exceptionally multifaceted—perfect for those who appreciate a natural, tea-forward profile with sophisticated depth.

Satyr Old School – Kentucky 100G Dark-Fired Kentucky • Smoky • Unflavored Robust Tobacco The bold, smoky essence of tradition. Kentucky is an intense, unflavored blend from Satyr’s Old School collection, crafted for aficionados who appreciate the raw, powerful taste of pure tobacco. It highlights the deeply rich, smoky, and earthy characteristics of fire-cured Kentucky Burley leaf , delivering heavy, woodsy notes reminiscent of a premium cigar or pipe tobacco. A highly robust and natural session designed for experienced smokers seeking an authentic, full-bodied tobacco flavor and a heavy buzz.

Satyr Old School – Lamba (100g) Spirit Series • Island Essence • Dark Rum & Sugar Cane The soul of the Caribbean in a tobacco leaf. Satyr Lamba is a legendary offering from the Old School collection, celebrating the authentic synergy of dark, fermented tobacco and premium aged rum. Unlike generic “liquor” flavors, Lamba focuses on the deep, molasses-heavy sweetness of traditional rum combined with the woody, slightly spicy notes of the barrel. Built on Satyr’s signature artisanal leaf, it delivers a medium-to-strong session with a robust tobacco body and a warm, boozy finish. It is an emotional and sophisticated choice for those who appreciate the raw, unadulterated craftsmanship of Russian spirit-infused shisha.

Satyr Old School – Neft (100g) Spirit Series • Pure Vodka Infusion • Bold & Raw Strength The raw energy of Russian craftsmanship. Satyr Neft (meaning “Oil” or “Petroleum”) is a hard-hitting masterpiece from the prestigious Old School collection. This blend focuses on the uncompromising synergy between premium fermented tobacco and high-purity grain spirits. Designed for the seasoned smoker, Neft offers a medium-to-strong session characterized by a sharp, “boozy” throat hit and a deep, earthy tobacco body with subtle notes of toasted grain. It is a bold, industrial-inspired smoke that celebrates the unadulterated strength and character of artisanal Russian shisha.

Satyr Old School – Tenderness (100g) Spirit Series • White Wine Infusion • Floral & Velvety Grace captured in smoke. Satyr Tenderness (Nezhnost) is a refined masterpiece from the prestigious Old School collection. This blend represents a sophisticated “synergy” between premium fermented tobacco and the elegant, crisp notes of expensive white wine. Unlike the bolder spirit infusions, Tenderness focuses on the velvety, floral esters and the light acidic brightness of the grape distillate. Built on Satyr’s artisanal craft leaf, it offers a medium-strength session with a smooth throat hit and a lingering, noble aftertaste. It is an emotional and intellectual smoke designed for those who appreciate subtlety and the natural beauty of the tobacco leaf.

Satyr Old School – Qirim Chacha (100g) Spirit Series • Grape Distillate • Southern Heritage Profile The spirited taste of the Black Sea coast. Satyr Qirim Chacha is a culturally rich highlight of the prestigious Old School collection. This blend captures the authentic synergy between dark fermented tobacco and “Chacha” — the legendary grape brandy of the Caucasus and Crimea. Characterized by the intense aroma of fermented grape pomace and a warming, boozy finish, it offers a medium-to-strong session with a deep, emotional body. Built on Satyr’s signature artisanal leaf, Qirim Chacha is a bold choice for those who appreciate traditional spirit infusions that highlight the natural strength and “soul” of the tobacco.

Satyr Old School – Saturn (100g) Spirit Series • Galactic Gin Infusion • Botanical & Juniper Profile An interstellar take on a classic spirit. Satyr Saturn is a sophisticated highlight of the prestigious Old School collection. This blend achieves a brilliant “synergy” by infusing premium fermented tobacco with the crisp, aromatic essence of dry gin. Expect a medium-to-strong session characterized by the sharp, refreshing notes of juniper berries, coriander, and a hint of citrus zest. Built on Satyr’s signature artisanal leaf, Saturn offers a clean, sophisticated, and slightly “cold” spirit profile that highlights the natural, earthy strength of the tobacco. It is an emotional and refined smoke for those who appreciate the complex botanicals of a high-end distillate.

Satyr Old School – Queen Anne’s Revenge 100G Indian Burley • Unflavored • Robust Tobacco Raw power fit for a legend. Named after the infamous flagship of the pirate Blackbeard, Queen Anne’s Revenge is a bold, uncompromising blend from Satyr’s Old School collection. Crafted for true tobacco purists, this unflavored shisha highlights the exceptionally rich, earthy, and intense characteristics of pure Indian Burley leaf . Expect a deeply robust, natural tobacco session that delivers heavy, full-bodied smoke and a formidable nicotine buzz.

The taste of mature bourbon unfolds with hints of caramel, fragrant oak and vanilla, and a slightly astringent aftertaste of dried fruits. Rich and complex, with a long velvety finish. According to one version, the name “bourbon” is linked to the French royal dynasty of the Bourbons, and we’ve crafted a truly royal flavor.

Description Serbetli made on the basis of honey, which gives it a slightly sweet natural taste. The cut of tobacco is quite large, the leaf is very well impregnated. The main difference from tobaccos of other manufacturers is heat resistance and high humidity, which allows you to enjoy the taste longer and heat the tobacco for more smokiness, while the tobacco does not taste bitter at all. This tobacco is great for beginners as it is very easy to make without fear of burning. Sherbetli is also famous for its very high smokiness, much higher than competitors such as Al Fakher or Nakhla. The Serbetli flavor line initially consisted of only 20 flavors, but in 2014 the line expanded significantly and now includes more than 60 flavors. Tobacco is produced in Turkey, in the city of Trabzon. Possible packaging is 50 and 250 grams. Serbetli is a great alternative to Starbuzz, but with a more natural taste. Of the advantages of tobacco – its smoke and heat resistance, of the minuses – low strength.

The Alpha Wave Killer Bowl is a high-performance phunnel bowl designed for intense, flavorful smoking sessions. Crafted from premium natural clay , it ensures even heat distribution and stable temperature throughout the session. Its innovative airflow design provides smooth pulls and maximizes the tobacco’s taste without overheating. The glazed inner surface prevents molasses absorption, keeping the bowl clean and extending its lifespan. Perfectly compatible with foil and most HMDs , the Wave Killer offers an ideal balance between heat control, density, and comfort — making it a favorite among both enthusiasts and professionals. Duft LYCHEE – The incredibly fragrant taste of Chinese grapes is amazing, conveying the juiciness of its pulp, sweetness and rich aroma. The taste of the tropical LYCHEE berry is revealed from the first seconds of smoking, is not lost throughout the entire process and impresses with its richness.

Duft MARASCHINO CHERRY – Would you like to try a cherry drunk from Maraschino liqueur? Then get ahead of everyone and take her to your home! Be gentle and courteous with MARASCHINO CHERRY, and you will remember the passionate hookah ceremony for a long time.

Duft MASHA & BEAR – A rich, moderately sweet fragrance of childhood memories. Do not wait for the season to enjoy the juiciest wild strawberries. Grab your grocery basket and go for strawberry nostalgia with MASHA & BEAR. Be careful, bears can get on the way!

Duft OBLEPIHA – It is difficult to determine the taste that lurks in sea buckthorn. Someone will feel a unique tart zest with a slightly sweet note of grapes, and someone will find a particularly pleasant invigorating trio of pineapple, lemon and cranberries. But one thing is certain – no one can resist the unique aroma of the berry of the sun. OBLEPIHA will quench your thirst in search of something incredible.

Duft ORANGE ZEST – An orange zest that will dilute the dullness of everyday life with its bright, sizzling mood and orange flavor. Stop putting off until tomorrow what you can do today. Fill the hookah with a “clockwork” orange, experience an incredibly long sweet and sour aftertaste and recharge with vitamins with ORANGE ZEST!

Duft PAN MASALA – Arabian night, here are flying carpets and the aroma of incredibly spicy herbs with nutty notes. Overseas exotic in its purest form! The original taste of Indian spices PAN MASALA, active and bright, excites from the first breath, intoxicates the mind and fills the lungs with an unusual combination of freshness and spice, and leaves a rich tart aftertaste on the exhale.

Duft PAPAYA – Drop everything and go to Brazil, India, or in extreme cases, southern Mexico in an instant right now. Think it’s impossible? The creamy taste of ripe papaya will convince you otherwise. The sweet aroma of juicy exotic fruit will give you a ticket to a tropical paradise where sun, sea, beach and PAPAYA await you. This is a lucky one way ticket.

Duft PEACH ICED TEA – A summer veranda, a warm June breeze and a glass of cool peach tea… Do you want it to be so atmospheric at any time of the year? Unfortunately, the weather conditions are beyond our control, but we have already made the aroma of chilled black tea with velvety peach, and it is waiting for you. Pour in PEACH ICED TEA and brew more and more.

Duft PEAR JAM – It is a golden pear, ripe, garden, sweet and sour, juicy, fragrant. That’s who she is! Feel at home with a generous helping of pear jam taken from your grandmother’s cellar. Duft PINEAPPLE – Collecting the most pineapple bouquet is not an easy task, but we did it! Feel the aroma of PINEAPPLE from the incredibly hot tropics, thanks to the bright, full-bodied taste of natural pineapple with a refreshing acidity and a rich floral-tropical aftertaste.

Duft PINK GRAPEFRUIT The original, sweet and sour taste of pink grapefruit, with a slight bitterness on the final note, reveals the versatility of the fruit. You have no idea what a true extravaganza you will experience on the first breath of PINK GRAPEFRUIT. And on the exhale, you will have a sweetish refreshing aftertaste of citrus pulp with a slight bitterness.

Duft PISTACHIO CREAM – The combination of tart nut and delicate creamy ice cream with a refreshing chill will amaze the mind, but the peak of PISTACHIO CREAM is felt on the exhale, leaving behind a pleasant, incomparable tart aftertaste.

Duft POMEGRANATE – You should no longer be afraid that you will stain the walls, T-shirt and everything around, because especially for lovers of this fruit we have prepared a pomegranate that you don’t have to suffer with! Refreshing, tart and slightly astringent aroma, has a pronounced sourness and aromas unusually similar to the original. In the aftertaste of POMEGRANATE, the astringency of the pomegranate seed is clearly felt, which gives the taste a special, unique charm.

Duft POMELO – While you are thinking about where to start on vacation, try teleporting to the marvelous, eternally sunny islands of Fiji, sitting at home. How? Easy, our mind-blowing taste of POMELO will help you with this. The largest member of the citrus family is 100% charged and ready to give you its unique, rich, sour honey aroma.

Duft RAFIKI – Delicate sweetish marula evenly opens and envelops from the first minutes of smoking, and a creamy note against the background of an exotic aroma in relation to a bright tobacco blend adds tenderness and leaves a pleasant, slightly tart aftertaste on the exhale. The unusual, mysterious taste of RAFIKI from the depths of Africa will conquer you from the first minutes.

Duft RASPBERRY – For the sake of this freshest aroma, I had to peel off all the bushes with raspberries nearby! The first breath will envelop you with the taste of the forest, ripe raspberries that you ate as a child. From the bright sensation of berry pulp with light grassy notes, you can lose your head! In the aftertaste of RASPBERRY there is an invigorating sourness and a tart aroma of velvety, raspberry seeds!

Duft RED CURRANT – If you sometimes began to have an irresistible desire to wander for your pleasure through the dense forest, then boldly go to the call of bright scarlet “beads” and you will be rewarded with a plentiful portion of the vitamin charge of red currant. Invitingly sour aroma with pleasant sweet undertones on the exhale. Chop a whole bunch of RED CURRANT and cheer up the environment.

Duft SCOTCH WHISKY – The spicy aroma of Scotch whiskey beckons you to take a sip. You lift a glass of drink to your lips, you feel its rich aroma and… you stop, remembering that your wild Jaguar is waiting for you below! But the evening is not spoiled, because there is tobacco with a bright aftertaste and intoxicating aroma of SCOTCH WHISKY.

Duft SOUR PEACH – After tasting this fragrance, you will discover a new palette of feelings and emotions. Rich with a smooth transition from sweetness to velvety sourness, the aroma is similar in taste to Nestea nectarine and peach iced tea. Incredibly ripe, fresh and juicy taste excites the receptors with new sensations, leaving a refreshing hint of floral notes in the aftertaste. The original fruit sits on the sidelines compared to SOUR PEACH.

Duft TARHUN – Greetings from the distant past, when the green drink consisted of natural ingredients! A powerful wave of nostalgia will cover you from the first breath. The sweet, herbaceous aroma of TARHUN with a slight hint of sourness takes you back to the past and is so strongly reminiscent of your favorite carbonated drink. Give in to temptation, score a full bowl!

Duft TIRAMISU – Pleasant, sweet, rich taste of a coffee dessert familiar to everyone. A light liqueur note without cloying is what will win the heart of a gourmet who is delighted with everything refined and refined. Delicate dessert flavor TIRAMISU will give you a gastronomic orgasm!

Duft WATERMELON – Thousands of ripe watermelons passed a tough casting, and dozens of the most juicy, sweet and refreshing berries were selected among them. An impartial jury has been working day and night so that you can enjoy the incredibly light melting aroma of the last summer month. Immerse yourself in a warm atmosphere at any time of the year with WATERMELON!

Duft WILDBERRY – The aroma of freshly picked wild berries growing in the depths of a coniferous forest will make you feel like a real hunter in pursuit of forest gifts. Having tried these berries once, you will not be able to forget the sensations of their natural fresh aroma. Making our way through the thorns of the thick forest, we collected a bouquet of the wildest, brightest and juiciest berries. Hurry, WILDBERRY might not stay!

Nash Indigo – it would seem – blueberries, raspberries and elderberries. How simple. But what is the mysterious indigo flower? After all, it was he who brought this combination to perfection, while retaining his secret. You don’t have to be indigo to feel it. Just try!

Nash Kiwi – very worthy and cool sweet kiwi, with a slight sourness. What does the taste of natural kiwi pulp have to do with it. Enveloping and versatile. It can be perfectly mixed with citrus or tropical flavors. And you can safely and happily smoke in solo!
Nash Last Samurai – the taste from the mixological line is sweet, with floral and berry notes of vanilla and jasmine. Very soft, light and tasty.
Nash Lavender/Feijoa – taste released in collaboration with hookah blogger Dava Dim – a top combination of grassy and slightly sour feijoa with sweet notes of lavender!

Nash Lemon – the long-awaited and unusual taste of a really sour lemon. It will be interesting to smoke solo, and can also be a great addition as a sourness to your mix. This taste should definitely be in your collection, as there are very few really good sour flavors.
Nash Lipton – the taste of fresh green tea, pleasant and refreshing. Somewhere even remind the taste of a well-known drink. It’s great for solos and works just as well in mixes.

Nash Lychee – the unusual taste of an exotic and very interesting lychee fruit-berry, which is somewhat similar to lychee. Not too bright, but nice sweet and sour. Great for driving in mixes to add an interesting tropical twist.

Nash May Tai – light cocktail with pineapple juice, lime and almond aftertaste. It is quite unusual, very attractive and most importantly – delicious! We advise you to try it solo for the first time, so that later you knead in mixes clearly and juicy!
Nash Mamba – the taste of Mamba chewing sweets familiar from childhood. It combines an orange marmalade base with hints of raspberries and sweet cherries.
Nash Mandarin – rich sweet and sour taste of ripe mandarin. Interesting and sweeter than an orange in its natural form. Pleasant citrus notes will perfectly brighten up almost any mix.
Nash Mango – Do you want to experience Thailand right now? This taste perfectly conveys all the sweet, grassy and slightly sour notes of a natural fruit and envelops with its tropical motives!

Nash Maraschino Cherry -familiar to many and popular taste of cocktail cherries. A rich and dignified cherry that is very cool to use in mixes. For example, you can mix with Bitterscotch – it will turn out very juicy!

Nash Oasis – The best citrus-tropical combination you can find on the market! Not chemo. All ingredients are perfectly balanced and complement each other. It’s hard to say what exactly is here, but pleasant notes of mango and citrus fruits definitely make their way through.
Nash Papaya – juicy and at the same time slightly creamy taste of exotic papaya fruit. With prevailing sweet notes of ripe fruit.

Nash Passion Fruit – another tropical taste, but this time it shows itself best in solo smokes. Pleasant sourness and sweetness are perfectly intertwined. But if you still decide to mix, then we recommend using citrus flavors to emphasize the sourness of passion fruit.
Nash Aloe Strawberry- the fusion of fresh Aloe with ripe and sweet strawberries.
Nash Kiwi Celery

Nash Passion Fruit/Avocado – taste released in collaboration with hookah blogger Dava Dym – this flavor combines cool sour notes of ripe passion fruit and healthy fat avocado. How did the guys achieve the taste of avocado, given that it itself is tasteless, but it turned out very tasty!
Nash Peach – juicy and velvety peach. Sweet, with a light, barely perceptible sourness. He is very cool and you can safely score and get high in solo!
Nash Peanut Butter – sweet and juicy peanut butter flavor that is so versatile that it can be soloed and enjoyed with sweet notes, as well as mixed to add a nice and unique touch to your shot!
Nash Pear – slightly refreshing and at the same time juicy, sweet and fragrant pear. Pleasant and very tasty goes solo. Enjoy, it’s really worth it!

Nash Pineapple – delicious and juicy, like most of the flavors of the NASH brand, ripe pineapple right in your bowl! He is so cool that you can safely score him in solo. And for tropical mixes, an indispensable ingredient! Take it for a try and enjoy.
Nash Pomergranate – tart, rich, very cool pomegranate. A taste that vividly conveys the natural notes of pomegranate pulp. It smokes quite comfortably in solo, and will be a great addition to mixes!
Nash Raspberry – rich sugar raspberry, with a pleasant sourness. Moderately sweet and overly tasty. It feels like you are popping a real raspberry! Great for solo smokes as well as mixes.
Nash Rondo – very cool taste of natural Rondo sweets! Refreshing motifs are perfect for any clogging, so the flight of your imagination can literally know no bounds!

Nash Skittles – a taste from the mixological line – do you remember what the legendary and popular Skittles sweets taste like? This is exactly how it is here! Sweet and sour taste, not oversaturated and quite versatile.

Nash Strawberry – juicy taste of bright, ripe strawberries freshly plucked from a sprig. It is moderately sour, moderately sweet and incredibly tasty! It is comfortable to smoke, both in solo and in mixes!

Nash Waffle – lovers of dessert flavors – this thing is especially for you! Disgracefully cool sweet waffles, with a pleasant vanilla aftertaste and milky notes. It smokes very comfortably and pleasantly.

Nash White Strawberry – the only flavor on the market that boasts incredible notes!! This is a definite TOP among all tastes! It intertwines bright juicy, sweet strawberry motifs, with interesting sour notes that resemble pineapple. Perhaps it is this combination that is unrealistically cool!

Duft BERRY BLAST – Watch out for vicious fruits, desserts and nuts coming at you! Duft BROWNIE – Are you the ultimate sweet tooth and love chocolate flavors? Then congratulations! This taste is what you have been looking for for so long. Duft CACTUS JACK – Having gone in search of unusual aromas, we ended up in Mexico and tasted a cactus for the first time. Duft CHAI LATTE – The creamy notes of Indian tea and its spicy aroma will immerse you in the atmosphere of the Indian tea ceremony. Sit back and explore Indian traditions with CHAI LATTE. Duft CHEESECAKE – It is impossible to describe this fragrance, you can only feel it! A taste that was created especially for the sweet tooth. Duft CHERRY JUICE – You can enjoy ripe cherries at any time of the year! Duft CRANBERRY – Refreshing and sour cranberries will help dilute your rest. Duft CUCUMBERITA – The laconic taste of summer lemonade with hints of cucumber will take you to a hot resort and cool you down from everyday worries. Duft DRAGON FRUIT – Dedicated to all lovers of tropical stories! Sweet, exotic pitahaya has traveled thousands of kilometers to find itself in your bowl. Taste the exotic! Light grassy notes with a melting, delicate taste of DRAGON FRUIT will give you true and blissful pleasure.

Not a single monkey was harmed while harvesting berries!
